description: Prompt for troubleshooting a blocked ticket: the root cause, and where its fix belongs (the product's board, or the harness's)

needs-fix.description: true if there is a real problem to fix

summary.description: The problem in one line, 120 characters or fewer

root-cause.description: The root cause, and the chain from it to the symptoms

cause-in.description: Where the cause is: project (a bug in the product's own code: its ticketing system), harness (the harness: its board), operator (the product's environment or the operator's machine: the harness's board)

evidence.description: What proves each claim: a command and its first error line, file:line, a log line; unchecked claims marked unverified
